name: FA-Leavev-Balace-Fix.SQL
content:
UPDATE HR_Leave_Balance b
SET b.Leave_Balance =
NVL((SELECT (nvl(l.Yearly_Balance,0)+nvl(l.ROUNDED_TRANSFERRED_BALANCE,0)) - nvl(l.LEAVE_TAKEN,0)
FROM HR_Employee_Leave l
WHERE l.HR_Employee_ID = b.HR_Employee_ID
AND l.C_Year_ID = b.C_Year_ID
AND l.HR_Leave_Type_ID = b.HR_Leave_Type_ID),0)

name: SCRIPT-FIX-M_StorageOnHand-CARTOON.sql
description: Fix the mismatch between On Hand qty and item card **Cartoon Projects**
content:
UPDATE M_STORAGEONHAND s
SET S.QTYONHAND =
NVL((SELECT SUM (t.movementqty)
FROM M_TRANSACTION t
WHERE T.M_PRODUCT_ID = s.M_PRODUCT_ID
AND t.m_locator_id = s.m_locator_id
AND t.m_attributesetinstance_id =
S.M_ATTRIBUTESETINSTANCE_ID),0)
